interpolation_exactness: For each fixed true r, distinct nodes and their repeated f/fprime data uniquely define Hermite H of degree at most27. Confluent divided-difference theorem proves exact H(node)=f(node), Hprime(node)=fprime(node); no zero-containing interval residual is promoted to equality.
minorant_lemma: For any t in [-1,1), Hermite remainder f(t)-H(t)=f^(28)(xi)/28! * product14(t-node_i)^2, with xi in hull of t and nodes. f^(28)(xi)=55!!*(2-2*xi)^(-57/2)>0, so H(t)<=f(t). All nodes lie in [-1,1). This real-calculus theorem is stated, not Lean formalized.
scope: Independent H27 and R_H coefficient construction with enclosure containment; no uniform error bound or K-factor check, no local nonnegativity or global tree witness proof.
